MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
